chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who married a woman while she had a husband, and he did not know, then the first [husband] divorced her or died, then the second [husband] found out: Should he remarry her? He said: No, until her waiting period expires.

key_terms.يُرَاجِعُهَا: He remarrys her / takes her back

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man marries a woman without knowing she is already married?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Istibsar, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the second marriage is not considered fully effective for consummation until the woman completes her 'iddah' from her first husband, ensuring the removal of any lingering marital ambiguity. This ruling highlights the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on the certainty of lineage and the proper transition of marital status, distinguishing between the validity of the contract and the permissibility of intimacy. It underscores the importance of verifying a spouse's status to prevent disputes over paternity and marital rights.
